title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Palace on 1969-03-29

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a scorching early‑'69 set highlighted by a fiery Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear, high‑fidelity sound that lets listeners hear every nuance of this brief but blazing early‑1970 performance. Reviewers rave about the hot energy, especially Jerry’s spoken intro to Dark Star and his soaring guitar work, noting it as a must‑hear for fans of the spring ’69 era. At just 1 hr 24 min the show feels like a tight three‑song burst that still packs plenty of classic Dead intensity.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed, enthusiastic review gives both superb musical performance and flawless recording quality; limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as excellent—clear, crisp, with no noted drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A very short (1 hr 24 min) set that likely consists of three early‑'69 numbers, delivering high energy and tight pacing typical of that era.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Introduces Dark Star with a spoken comment about writing it that morning for the Ice House; guitar tone praised as hot.
